title: Git LFS HTTP redirects can disclose cookies to another origin
summary: Git LFS can forward Cookie headers to an unintended destination after an HTTP redirect. The advisory explicitly states that Authorization headers are not forwarded to inappropriate hosts.

severity.rationale: The flaw can disclose credentials carried in cookies across an origin boundary. Authenticated source and CI workflows can supply these headers.

exposure: LFS requests must carry sensitive cookies and encounter redirects to another origin.

params.instructions: Check Git LFS version and whether the documented exposure conditions apply.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Upgrade Git LFS to 3.8.1 or later.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed component uses the patched release and test the affected workflow with harmless inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
